name: Kisuke Urahara

power.name: Benihime
power.notes: A versatile crimson-energy blade capable of offensive blasts, shields, and anatomical restructuring.

powerSteps.title: Shikai
powerSteps.name: Benihime
powerSteps.desc: A cane sword that awakens into a crimson-hilted blade projecting versatile crimson reishi sheets and binding nets.

powerSteps.title: Bankai
powerSteps.name: Kannonbiraki Benihime Aratame
powerSteps.desc: Manifests a colossal benevolent mannequin that cuts open and stitches back together anything within its domain for spatial restructuring or physical reconstruction.

powerSteps.title: Mastery
powerSteps.name: High-Tier Kido & Inventions
powerSteps.desc: Commands forbidden level 90+ Kido spells without incantation and deploys tactical seal matrices to neutralize god-tier threats.

blurb: An eccentric shopkeeper who masks towering genius behind wooden clogs and a striped bucket hat. As the founder of the Research and Development Institute, he stays three moves ahead of every adversary.

name: Yoruichi Shihoin

power.name: Shunkō & Hakuda Mastery
power.notes: Foregoes carrying a Zanpakuto to rely on pinnacle unarmed hand-to-hand combat and lightning-infused pressure.

powerSteps.title: Signature Art
powerSteps.name: Shunkō
powerSteps.desc: Fuses advanced Hakuda hand-to-hand combat with concentrated Kido to cloak the shoulders in surging lightning and pulverizing force.

powerSteps.title: Advanced Form
powerSteps.name: Shunkō: Raijin Senkei
powerSteps.desc: Summons a glowing halo of lightning drums above her spine that discharge continuous localized electrical storms.

powerSteps.title: Tactical Gear
powerSteps.name: Anti-Hierro Armor & Wire
powerSteps.desc: Equips resilient reinforced metal gauntlets and razor steel wires capable of fracturing hardened Arrancar carapaces.

blurb: The 22nd hereditary leader of the noble Shihoin clan and undisputed master of high-speed flash step. She dominates battlefields with lightning-infused martial arts and supreme agility.

name: Tessai Tsukabishi

power.name: Forbidden Kido Mastery

powerSteps.desc: Erects ancient multi-layered barriers and halts the local passage of time to quarantine spatial hazards.

blurb: A quiet shop assistant whose apron belies his former title as the supreme leader of the Soul Society Kido Corps. His spells bend spatial barriers and counter high-level hollow energy.
